Description:
[center][b]ENDANGERED SPECIMENS  MOD - MERMAID[/b][/center]
[center][left][b]-This mod does not work on Android-[/b][/left]

[left][b]ENDANGERED SPECIES FOUND IN STARDEW VALLEY! In ancient times, before stardew valley was well...[/b][b] [/b][i][b]stardew valley, [/b][/i]different species ruled the land before any humans. It's not certain what caused the vanishing of these unique creatures but if you're lucky enough, you still have a chance to bring them back to the valley! The sad thing is that there's only one member left of each species. It's your choice to let the last species live or sell it's egg for gold.[/left]
[left]
[b]HOW TO FIND A MERMAID EGG?:[/b][/left]
[left]You have a 7% chance of catching a "mysterious egg" by fishing in the ses. The egg  radiates a dark siren aura in the dark.[/left]
[left][/left]
[left]SPOILER (EVENT STEPS)
[spoiler]1. Catch a mysterious egg
2.Talk to ghunter about the egg
3.Select yes or no for choosing to raise the egg
4.If selected yes, wait 1 in game day and then talk to Robin (talk to her directly do not shop from her)
5. After you pay for the tank, wait for 2 in game days
6. After 2 days a mermaid tank will appear in your inventory
7. Place the mermaid egg inside the tank right in the middle and wait for it to hatch in 2 days

[b]EGG HATCHING AND CARE:[/b]
-2 days after placing the egg into the tank, the egg will hatch into a "baby mermaid".  You need to feed your baby mermaid everyday. It will grow into an adult mermaid in 3 days. You can feed your mermaid [i][b][u]any algae or fish.

-Adult mermaid produce [u]a pearl [/u]every day. Occasionaly she can give you [u]an aquamarine, a treasure chest or an ocean stone[/u] too.

[u]-Every 50 game days the mermaid gives you a prismatic shard.[/u]

-if you fail to feed your mermaid for more than 5 days your mermaid will di [/u][/b][/i][/spoiler]

[b]CHEAT SHEET:
[/b]A README.txt file is included in the mod folder of the SMAPI command of spawning another mermaid egg in case it dies or you just want another one. Just remember that each tank can host only one mermaid.

Creator's Note: I will add different species into the game but in the meantime enjoy this mermaid one![/left]
